name: x-collect-topic
title: Collect posts about a topic on X
summary: Search X, switch to Latest, and read the newest posts with their authors, keeping only the ones genuinely about the topic.
description: Searches X from the phone's logged-in account, sorts by Latest, and reads the results as it scrolls. Each post is scored against a claim you write, so a search for a term that has another everyday meaning still returns the posts you meant. Because it runs in the app as the signed-in account, it sees what that account sees, including posts from protected accounts it follows.
output: One record per post with the author and the post text, plus p_on_topic, the probability the claim held for it.

topic.description: What to search for, typed into X's search box exactly as given

claim.description: What a wanted post is, as a statement about one post. Posts are kept when this is probably true of them.
claim.example: the post is about the EB-2 NIW immigration visa, not the letters used casually

count.description: How many matching posts to collect before stopping

bar.description: How sure the claim must be to keep a post

phases.title: Search X and read the Latest results
phases.goal: In the X app, tap the Explore or Search tab, tap the search field, type '{{topic}}', and submit the search. On the results screen tap the Latest tab so the newest posts are showing, then keep scrolling down the results. Do not like, repost, reply, follow or open any post.
steps: The Latest tab of the results is selected

collect.record: a post in the search results

fields.author: the display name or @handle of the account that posted it

collect.where: the Latest tab of the search results is showing
